title: Max the Dog
text:
Tom has a small dog named Max. Every morning, Max wakes Tom up early. They go to the park together. Max likes to run and play with a red ball.

After the park, Tom and Max go home. Tom gives Max a big bowl of water. Then they sit on the sofa and read a book. Tom loves his dog very much.

questions.text: What is the name of the dog?
What color is the ball Max plays with?
How does Max probably feel at the park?
options: He is scared of the park.
He is bored at the park.
He is happy at the park.
He is tired of the park.

questions.text: Why does Tom probably love Max so much?
options: Because Max lives at the park.
Because they spend time together and have fun.

paragraph_translations: У Тома є маленький пес на ім'я Макс. Кожного ранку Макс будить Тома рано. Вони разом ідуть до парку. Макс любить бігати і грати з червоним м'ячем.
Після парку Том і Макс ідуть додому. Том дає Максу велику миску води. Потім вони сидять на дивані й читають книжку. Том дуже любить свого пса.
